name: Oslo Lounge Armchair
description: Scandinavian-inspired armchair crafted from solid oak with premium linen upholstery. Perfect for reading nooks and cozy corners.

name: Aura Ceramic Table Lamp
description: Hand-thrown ceramic lamp with a textured matte glaze and natural linen shade. Casts a warm, ambient glow.

name: Terra Artisan Vase
description: Handcrafted terracotta vase with an organic, irregular silhouette. Each piece is unique due to the artisan process.

name: Halo Round Wall Mirror
description: Statement wall mirror with a slim brushed-gold frame. Opens up any room and adds a touch of modern elegance.

name: Luxe Velvet Cushion
description: Deep teal velvet cushion with gold piping detail. Layer multiples for a plush, designer look.

name: Horizon Floating Shelf
description: Dark walnut floating shelf with concealed iron brackets. Minimalist storage that doubles as a display ledge.

name: Sahara Woven Area Rug
description: Hand-woven jute and cotton rug with geometric diamond pattern. Adds warmth and texture to any living space.

name: Noir Soy Candle Trio
description: Set of three hand-poured soy candles in matte black vessels with wooden lids. Scents: Amber, Cedar, and Vanilla.
